description: This file defines a C# interface named IClientAddressableTestConsumer within the namespace UnitTests.GrainInterfaces. The interface extends IGrainWithIntegerKey and declares two asynchronous methods: PollProducer returning a Task<int> and Setup returning a Task.

classes.name: IClientAddressableTestConsumer
classes.description: An interface for a grain consumer with methods for polling a producer and setup.

methods.name: PollProducer
methods.description: Asynchronously polls a producer, returning an integer result.
